title: DiVid: Diagnosing Dimension-Specific Diversity Collapse in Video Generation Models
title_zh: DiVid：诊断视频生成模型中维度特定的多样性崩塌

paragraphs.en: Despite remarkable progress, video generation models often produce highly similar outputs when repeatedly sampled from the same prompt, limiting their usefulness for creative exploration. Existing diversity evaluations primarily rely on global scalar metrics, which obscure where diversity collapses in the spatiotemporal space of videos. We introduce DiVid , a dimension-level diagnostic framework that decomposes video generation diversity into six interpretable dimensions: Semantic, Style, Subject, Scene, Motion, and Camera. Each dimension is measured through a reproducible computer-vision pipeline and analyzed alongside quality and instruction faithfulness to examine potential trade-offs. Systematic evaluation of representative video generation models reveals that diversity is highly dimension-specific: models with strong global diversity scores still collapse on specific factors, particularly Motion and Camera. These rankings persist after filtering unfaithful generations, indicating genuine capability differences rather than off-prompt outputs. Beyond measurement, controlled prompt interventions identify two fundamental bottlenecks: default mode convergence, where models fall back to dominant patterns under open-ended prompts; and realization gaps, where models fail to faithfully realize diverse, explicitly requested alternatives, particularly for temporal factors. The larger faithfulness losses for temporal factors highlight the difficulty of controlling motion and camera variation through text alone. DiVid thus shifts the study of diversity from measuring whether it exists to diagnosing where and why it collapses, and provides actionable directions for dimension-aware training objectives and control signals. The framework will be released to facilitate future research on diverse and controllable video generation.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管取得了显著进展，视频生成模型在从同一提示词反复采样时往往产生高度相似的输出，这限制了其在创意探索中的实用性。 现有的多样性评估主要依赖全局标量指标，这掩盖了多样性在视频时空空间中的坍缩位置。 我们提出 DiVid，一个维度级诊断框架，将视频生成多样性分解为六个可解释的维度：语义、风格、主体、场景、运动和镜头。 每个维度通过可复现的计算机视觉流程进行测量，并与质量和指令忠实度一并分析，以考察潜在的权衡关系。 对代表性视频生成模型的系统性评估表明，多样性具有高度的维度特异性：全局多样性得分较高的模型在特定因素上仍会出现坍缩，尤其是运动和镜头。 在过滤掉不忠实的生成结果后，这些排名依然保持不变，表明这是真实的能力差异，而非偏离提示词的输出。 除测量之外，受控的提示词干预识别出两个根本性瓶颈：默认模式收敛，即模型在开放式提示词下回退到主导模式；以及实现差距，即模型无法忠实实现多样化的、明确要求的替代方案，尤其是时间性因素。 时间性因素上更大的忠实度损失凸显了仅通过文本控制运动和镜头变化的困难。 因此，DiVid 将多样性的研究从测量其是否存在转向诊断其在何处以及为何坍缩，并为维度感知的训练目标和控制信号提供了可操作的方向。 该框架将被公开发布，以促进多样化且可控的视频生成的未来研究。

paragraphs.en: Recent advances in video generation have enabled models to produce visually compelling and increasingly realistic videos from text prompts [ 21 , 8 , 24 ] . However, as these models become more aligned for high-quality generation, a limitation is becoming increasingly apparent: different samples generated from the same prompt often converge to highly similar outputs (illustrated in Figure 1 ). A model may repeatedly generate the same subject appearance, scene composition, camera trajectory, or motion pattern, despite the large space of possible valid interpretations. Such homogenization has been observed in large language models and text-to-image systems [ 31 , 18 , 14 , 60 , 68 ] . Video encodes spatiotemporal signals with far broader creative spaces, but its diversity remains poorly understood.
paragraphs.zh: 视频生成领域的最新进展使得模型能够根据文本提示生成视觉上引人入胜且日益逼真的视频 [ 21 , 8 , 24 ] 。 然而，随着这些模型不断对齐以实现高质量生成，一个局限性正变得日益明显：由同一提示生成的不同样本往往收敛到高度相似的输出（如图 1 所示）。 尽管可能的有效解释空间巨大，模型仍可能反复生成相同的主体外观、场景构图、相机轨迹或运动模式。 这种同质化现象已在大语言模型和文生图系统中被观察到 [ 31 , 18 , 14 , 60 , 68 ] 。 视频承载的时空信号具有远为广阔的创作空间，但其多样性仍鲜被理解。

paragraphs.en: Diversity is a fundamental capability of generative models rather than merely an aesthetic preference. In practical applications, users often provide high-level intentions instead of fully specified scripts and expect generation systems to explore multiple plausible creative directions [ 25 , 47 , 13 , 12 ] . Limited diversity reduces the usefulness of generation systems by requiring excessive resampling, and may compress human creativity [ 31 ] and amplify bias [ 6 , 42 ] at billion-user scale. More fundamentally, homogenization reveals where models fail to represent the underlying distribution of possible visual worlds [ 71 , 30 ] : a model that defaults to certain appearances, environments, or motion patterns may reflect biases in training data or objectives [ 55 , 70 , 10 ] . Long-tailed class-imbalanced training data causes model collapse on tail concepts [ 48 , 66 , 22 ] , while balanced data resampling degrades overall fidelity [ 48 , 23 ] . Targeted recovery thus requires locating the collapsed dimension.
paragraphs.zh: 多样性是生成模型的一项基础能力，而不仅仅是一种审美偏好。 在实际应用中，用户通常提供的是高层意图，而非完全指定的脚本，并期望生成系统能够探索多种合理的创作方向 [ 25 , 47 , 13 , 12 ] 。 有限的多样性会因需要过度重复采样而降低生成系统的实用性，并可能在数十亿用户规模下压缩人类创造力 [ 31 ] 、放大偏见 [ 6 , 42 ] 。 更根本地说，同质化揭示了模型在哪些方面无法表征可能视觉世界的底层分布 [ 71 , 30 ] ：默认呈现某些外观、环境或运动模式的模型，可能反映了训练数据或训练目标中的偏差 [ 55 , 70 , 10 ] 。 长尾的类别不平衡训练数据会导致模型在尾部概念上发生坍塌 [ 48 , 66 , 22 ] ，而平衡的数据重采样则会降低整体保真度 [ 48 , 23 ] 。 因此，有针对性的恢复需要定位发生坍塌的维度。

paragraphs.en: Despite its importance, diagnosing diversity in video generation remains challenging. Existing video generation benchmarks primarily focus on quality, alignment and temporal consistency [ 26 , 53 , 40 ] . Beyond individual samples, recent diversity metrics [ 69 , 33 ] measure it through global scalars, which obscure fundamentally different failure modes. For example, a model may generate diverse scenes while producing identical camera motions, or vary subject appearance while maintaining the same visual style. These models may obtain similar overall diversity scores but require completely different solutions. Existing metrics thus answer whether diversity exists; advancing diversity requires diagnosing where and how it collapses.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管多样性十分重要，诊断视频生成中的多样性仍然具有挑战性。 现有的视频生成基准主要关注质量、对齐和时间一致性 [ 26 , 53 , 40 ] 。 超越单个样本的层面，近期的多样性度量 [ 69 , 33 ] 通过全局标量来衡量多样性，这掩盖了根本不同的失败模式。 例如，一个模型可能生成多样的场景，却产生完全相同的镜头运动；或者变化主体外观，却保持相同的视觉风格。 这些模型可能获得相近的整体多样性分数，但需要完全不同的解决方案。 因此，现有度量只能回答多样性是否存在；而推进多样性则需要诊断它在哪里以及如何崩塌。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we introduce DiVid , a dimension-resolved diagnostic framework for understanding diversity in video generation. Rather than a single global property, DiVid profiles diversity along six complementary and human-aligned dimensions: Semantic and Style diversity at the holistic level, and Subject, Scene, Motion, and Camera diversity at the factor level, each complemented by quality and faithfulness metrics to ensure that measured diversity is genuine. For each dimension, we design a dedicated extraction-and-comparison pipeline built from off-the-shelf computer vision tools, enabling reproducible, localized diagnosis of diversity strengths and failures.
paragraphs.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出了 DiVid，一个按维度解析的诊断框架，用于理解视频生成中的多样性。 不同于单一的全局属性，DiVid 沿六个互补且与人类对齐的维度刻画多样性：整体层面的语义多样性与风格多样性，以及要素层面的主体、场景、运动与镜头多样性，每个维度均辅以质量和忠实度指标，以确保所测得的多样性是真实可靠的。 针对每个维度，我们设计了由现成计算机视觉工具构建的专用提取与比较流程，从而实现对多样性优势与不足的可复现、可定位的诊断。

paragraphs.en: We conduct extensive evaluations on representative video generation models. Our results reveal that diversity is highly dimension-specific: no model dominates across all dimensions, and different models exhibit distinct collapse patterns. Models with strong global diversity scores still collapse on temporal factors such as motion and camera. Lowering the guidance scale does not uniformly lift all dimensions, and diversity rankings disagree with quality and faithfulness rankings. These rankings persist after filtering unfaithful generations, confirming that they reflect genuine capability gaps rather than off-prompt variation. These findings demonstrate that existing global metrics can mask important capability differences between models.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在具有代表性的视频生成模型上进行了广泛的评估。 我们的结果表明，多样性高度依赖于具体维度：没有任何一个模型能在所有维度上都占优，不同的模型呈现出各不相同的坍缩模式。 全局多样性得分较高的模型，在运动和镜头等时间性因素上仍然会出现坍缩。 降低引导系数并不能一致地提升所有维度，且多样性排名与质量和忠实度排名并不一致。 在过滤掉不忠实的生成结果后，这些排名依然存在，证实它们反映的是真实的能力差距，而非偏离提示词的波动。 这些发现表明，现有的全局指标可能掩盖模型之间重要的能力差异。

paragraphs.en: Through controlled prompt interventions that manipulate individual dimensions, we identify two fundamental bottlenecks. First, default-mode convergence : when a target factor is unspecified or only broadly hinted, models converge to dominant patterns rather than exploring plausible alternatives. Second, realization gaps : explicitly enumerating alternatives expands output span, but models do not consistently realize the requested candidates, particularly for Motion and Camera, echoing the guidance-scale findings above. Improving diversity thus requires dimension-aware objectives and control signals, not a single universal diversity metric.
paragraphs.zh: 通过对单个维度进行受控的提示干预，我们识别出两个根本性的瓶颈。 第一，默认模式收敛：当目标因素未被指定或仅有宽泛的暗示时，模型会收敛到主导模式，而不是探索合理的替代选项。 第二，实现差距：明确列举替代选项会扩大输出范围，但模型并不能稳定地实现所要求的候选内容，尤其是在 Motion 和 Camera 维度上，这与上文关于引导尺度的发现相呼应。 因此，提升多样性需要维度感知的目标和控制信号，而不是单一的通用多样性指标。

paragraphs.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows: 1) We introduce DiVid , a dimension-level diagnostic framework that decomposes video diversity into six interpretable dimensions and provides localized analysis of diversity collapse; 2) We systematically evaluate representative video generation models and reveal that diversity is highly dimension-specific, with substantial gaps hidden by existing global metrics; 3) Through controlled intervention studies, we identify two fundamental diversity bottlenecks, default mode convergence and realization gaps, providing actionable directions for data curation, training objectives, and generation strategies.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的贡献总结如下：1）我们提出了 DiVid，一个维度级诊断框架，将视频多样性分解为六个可解释的维度，并对多样性坍缩进行局部化分析；2）我们系统地评估了具有代表性的视频生成模型，揭示出多样性具有高度的维度特异性，且现有全局指标掩盖了其中存在的巨大差距；3）通过受控干预研究，我们识别出两个根本性的多样性瓶颈——默认模式趋同和实现差距，为数据筛选、训练目标和生成策略提供了可操作的方向。

paragraphs.en: Video Generation Evaluation. Video generation benchmarks have progressed from general-purpose protocols [ 41 , 40 ] to fine-grained dimensions [ 26 , 53 , 69 ] . However, these efforts predominantly score quality or faithfulness on a per-video basis. When diversity is considered, some works provide holistic global scores [ 16 , 26 , 27 , 69 ] . Recent prompt-aware methods separate model-induced from prompt-induced variation [ 46 , 29 , 28 ] . However, they provide limited attribution to the subject, scene, or motion level, and thus lack the fine-grained diagnostic capability.

paragraphs.en: Diversity and Homogeneity in Generative Models. Homogenization in generative AI has been independently proved in text [ 31 ] , image [ 18 , 14 ] , and video generation [ 70 , 55 ] , with alignment training further shown to worsen mode collapse [ 37 , 10 ] . Existing mitigation strategies expand the output distribution through prompt rewriting [ 33 , 34 ] , joint sampling [ 39 ] , or reward optimization [ 37 ] , yet predominantly rely on global objectives. While diversity evaluation has been studied in image generation [ 18 , 60 , 3 , 68 , 1 ] , such systematic evaluation remains largely absent in video generation.

paragraphs.en: Guided by film theory and video representation studies [ 7 , 54 , 36 ] , a video can be perceived holistically through its content semantics and overall appearance, and be further decomposed along spatial composition (foreground subject, background scene) and temporal dynamics (subject motion, camera movement). Accordingly, we construct a two-level, six-dimensional diagnostic framework. The Holistic level (Semantic, Style) captures overall variation using established representation spaces; the Factor level further decomposes diversity into four dimensions: spatial composition (Subject, Scene) and temporal dynamics (Motion, Camera). Figure 2 illustrates the complete framework pipeline.
paragraphs.zh: 受电影理论与视频表征研究 [7, 54, 36] 的启发，视频可以通过其内容语义与整体外观进行整体感知，并可进一步沿空间构成（前景主体、背景场景）与时间动态（主体运动、镜头运动）进行分解。 据此，我们构建了一个两级、六维度的诊断框架。 整体层面（语义、风格）利用已有的表征空间捕捉整体变化；因子层面进一步将多样性分解为四个维度：空间构成（主体、场景）与时间动态（运动、镜头）。 图 2 展示了完整的框架流程。

paragraphs.en: All dimensions share a unified evaluation paradigm: extract a dimension-specific representation for each video, compute a pairwise similarity matrix, and aggregate it into a set-level diversity score. The holistic Semantic and Style dimensions adapt image-level diversity kernels [ 46 , 27 ] to video through frame-level aggregation; the remaining four factor-resolved dimensions introduce pipelines combining detection, segmentation, tracking, and motion decomposition to achieve dimension-level decoupled evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 所有维度共享统一的评估范式：为每个视频提取特定于该维度的表示，计算成对相似度矩阵，并将其聚合为集合级的多样性得分。 整体性的语义与风格维度通过帧级聚合将图像级多样性核 [ 46 , 27 ] 适配到视频；其余四个因子分解的维度则引入结合检测、分割、跟踪与运动分解的流水线，以实现维度级解耦评估。

The Subject dimension extracts subject crops and encodes them with DINOv2 [ 45 ] to measure differences in subject appearance. The Scene dimension masks the subject region and encodes the resulting background-focused frames with DINOv2 to capture environmental differences.

paragraphs.en: This group disentangles two motion components: global camera movement and subject motion. The Camera dimension mainly fits a global affine transformation (translation, scaling, and rotation) to background trajectories extracted by CoTracker [ 32 ] , capturing differences in camera movement patterns and pace. The Motion dimension first compensates subject trajectories by removing estimated camera transform, then combines the resulting relative trajectories with canonicalized RAFT [ 59 ] optical flow to capture subject locomotion and internal deformation. This joint design minimizes leakage between camera movement and subject motion.

paragraphs.en: We validate the shared localization and each dimension through automatic validity filtering, human mask inspection, and strict-validity sensitivity analysis. The prompt–dimension invalid rates are only 0.83% for Subject and Scene, 0.76% for Motion, and 0.69% for Camera; invalid records are excluded rather than assigned zero. The corresponding four-dimension model-level rate ranges from 0% to 2.79%. Further human verification on 300 randomly sampled masks indicates that 93.3% contain neither salient foreground omission nor background leakage. Moreover, the dimension leaders remain unchanged when every model is required to retain at least 8 of 10 valid videos. Details and sensitivity checks are in Appendix B.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过自动有效性过滤、人工掩码检查以及严格有效性敏感性分析，对共享定位及每个维度进行验证。 提示词—维度的无效率仅为：Subject 0.83%、Scene 0.83%、Motion 0.76%、Camera 0.69%；无效记录被排除而非计为零。 相应的四维模型层面无效率介于 0% 到 2.79% 之间。 对随机抽取的 300 个掩码进行的进一步人工核查表明，其中 93.3% 既没有明显的前景遗漏，也没有背景泄漏。 此外，当要求每个模型至少保留 10 个有效视频中的 8 个时，各维度的领先者保持不变。 详细内容与敏感性检查见附录 B.3。

paragraphs.en: We prove the non-interchangeability and diagnostic value of the four factor-level dimensions through prompt-grouped cross-factor prediction, leave-one-factor-out diagnosis, and dimension-selective pair retrieval. The other three factors leave 58.1–73.4% of each held-out factor’s variance unexplained; removing one factor changes the prompt-level top-model set for 19.5–26.7% of prompts. Each factor retrieves selective video pairs in 74.7–93.3% of the prompts. Thus, Subject, Scene, Motion, and Camera expose factor-specific, decision-relevant failures that a global metric would miss, detailed in Appendix B.5 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过按提示分组的跨因子预测、留一因子诊断和维度选择性配对检索，证明了四个因子级维度的不可互换性及其诊断价值。 其余三个因子会留下每个留存因子58.1%–73.4%的方差无法解释；移除一个因子会使19.5%–26.7%的提示的提示级最优模型集合发生变化。 每个因子在74.7%–93.3%的提示中检索出选择性的视频对。 因此，Subject、Scene、Motion 和 Camera 揭示了因子特异的、与决策相关的失败，而全局指标会遗漏这些失败，详见附录 B.5。

paragraphs.en: It measures whether a video adheres to the prompt, ensuring valid diversity. A VLM (Qwen3.6-27B [ 4 ] ) judge extracts the constraints for a single factor-level dimension (subject, scene, motion, or camera) from the prompt and independently assesses whether the generated video satisfies that dimension, assigning a score from 1 to 5, which is then linearly normalized to [0.2, 1]. The unconstrained dimension is marked N/A and Overall IF averages all applicable factor scores.
paragraphs.zh: 它衡量视频是否遵循提示词，从而确保有效的多样性。 一个 VLM（Qwen3.6-27B [ 4 ]）裁判从提示词中提取单一因素-等级维度（主体、场景、运动或镜头）的约束条件，并独立评估生成的视频是否满足该维度，给出 1 到 5 的分数，随后线性归一化到 [0.2, 1]。 未受约束的维度标记为 N/A，整体 IF 对所有适用的因素分数取平均。

paragraphs.en: We employ Aesthetic Quality (AQ) and Imaging Quality (IQ) from VBench [ 26 ] to characterize visual fidelity, while the original VBench Temporal Flickering (TF) and Motion Smoothness (MS) metrics assess motion quality, ensuring that the observed diversity does not arise from artifacts or temporal degradation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们采用 VBench [26] 中的美学质量（AQ）和成像质量（IQ）来刻画视觉保真度，同时使用原始的 VBench 时间闪烁（TF）和运动平滑度（MS）指标来评估运动质量，以确保所观察到的多样性并非源于伪影或时间退化。

paragraphs.en: Following DPP-GRPO [ 33 ] , we report TCE and TIE as global set-level references that measure the spread of generated videos in CLIP and Inception feature spaces, respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 遵循 DPP-GRPO [ 33 ]，我们将 TCE 和 TIE 作为全局集合级参考指标进行报告，分别用于衡量生成视频在 CLIP 和 Inception 特征空间中的分散程度。

paragraphs.en: Prompt Construction. We construct our prompt set from two existing benchmarks to ensure generality, reproducibility, and broad coverage: VBench-Category [ 26 ] (8 general content categories), VBench-Dimension (10 quality dimensions), and T2V-CompBench [ 53 ] (7 categories of compositional constraints), sampling 10, 7, and 8 prompts per category respectively, for a total of 206 general prompts. All results reported are aggregated across the full prompt set; per-source breakdowns are provided in Appendix C.5 and show consistent trends.
paragraphs.zh: 提示词构建。 我们从两个现有基准构建提示词集合，以确保通用性、可复现性和广泛覆盖：VBench-Category [26]（8 个通用内容类别）、VBench-Dimension（10 个质量维度）和 T2V-CompBench [53]（7 个组合约束类别），每个类别分别采样 10、7 和 8 条提示词，共计 206 条通用提示词。 所有报告的结果均在完整提示词集合上汇总；按来源划分的结果见附录 C.5，且显示出一致的趋势。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Table 1 , homogenization in video generation is dimension-specific and cannot be characterized by any single global score.

paragraphs.en: In Figure 3 , Wan2.2-5B ranks first in Semantic, Style, Subject, and Scene, but falls into the bottom two in Motion and Camera. Hunyuan exhibits the opposite profile: it ranks first in both Motion and Camera, but only fourth to sixth across the four content dimensions. Similar reversals appear beyond the two leaders. Seedance ranks second in both temporal dimensions but sixth in Style, Subject, and Scene, whereas CogVideo ranks second in Subject but last in Motion and Camera. Overall, six of the seven models span at least three rank positions across the six dimensions. Prompt-paired bootstrap (20,000 resamples) and two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank tests with Benjamini–Hochberg correction confirm the central rank reversal, detailed in Appendix C.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 在图 3 中，Wan2.2-5B 在 Semantic、Style、Subject 和 Scene 上排名第一，但在 Motion 和 Camera 上跌入最后两名。 Hunyuan 呈现出相反的特征：它在 Motion 和 Camera 上均排名第一，但在四个内容维度上仅排名第四至第六。 在两位领先者之外，类似的反转也出现了。 Seedance 在两个时间维度上均排名第二，但在 Style、Subject 和 Scene 上排名第六；而 CogVideo 在 Subject 上排名第二，却在 Motion 和 Camera 上垫底。 总体而言，七个模型中有六个在六个维度间的排名跨度至少为三名。 提示词配对自助法（20,000 次重采样）以及经 Benjamini–Hochberg 校正的双侧 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验证实了核心的排名反转，详见附录 C.1。

paragraphs.en: Both TCE and TIE rank Wan2.2-5B first. These scores are close to Hunyuan’s 5.05 and 13.07, yet their factor-level results are fundamentally different: Hunyuan achieves 1.33 × 1.33\times higher Motion MPD and 5.05 × 5.05\times higher Camera MPD, while Wan2.2-5B leads all four content dimensions. Additionally, Camera MPD spans a 10.8 × \times gap—from 0.490 (Hunyuan) to 0.045 (CogVideo). Thus, global metrics can summarize aggregate spread, but they neither preserve the full factor-level profile nor identify the source of homogenization. This diagnostic gap motivates factor-specific evaluation and optimization objectives.
paragraphs.zh: TCE 和 TIE 均将 Wan2.2-5B 排在首位。 这些分数接近 Hunyuan 的 5.05 和 13.07，但其因子级结果存在根本差异：Hunyuan 的 Motion MPD 高出 1.33 × 1.33\times，Camera MPD 高出 5.05 × 5.05\times，而 Wan2.2-5B 在全部四个内容维度上领先。 此外，Camera MPD 跨越了 10.8 × \times 的差距——从 0.490（Hunyuan）到 0.045（CogVideo）。 因此，全局指标可以总结总体离散程度，但既不能保留完整的因子级画像，也无法定位同质化的来源。 这一诊断上的缺口促使我们提出针对因子的评估与优化目标。

paragraphs.en: Achieving high quality, instruction faithfulness, and rich diversity simultaneously remains a fundamental challenge in current video generation. HappyHorse ranks first in instruction faithfulness (IF=0.986) and imaging quality (IQ=0.729), yet ranks last in Semantic, Style, Subject, and Scene diversity. Conversely, Wan2.2-5B leads the four dimensions. At the prompt level, 35 of 49 significant correlations (after FDR correction) are negative (Table 14 ). Selecting a model from a quality leaderboard may favor the homogeneous one.
paragraphs.zh: 同时实现高质量、指令忠实度和丰富的多样性，仍然是当前视频生成中的一项根本性挑战。 HappyHorse 在指令忠实度（IF=0.986）和成像质量（IQ=0.729）上排名第一，但在语义、风格、主体和场景多样性上排名垫底。 相反，Wan2.2-5B 在这四个维度上领先。 在提示词层面，49 个显著相关性（经 FDR 校正后）中有 35 个为负相关（表 14）。 从质量排行榜中挑选模型可能会偏向同质化的模型。

paragraphs.en: Section 4 reports dimension-wise diversity profiles on general-purpose benchmark prompts. Here, we use controlled prompts that deliberately leave a target dimension open, isolating scenarios where diversity in the target dimension is expected. This design distinguishes three behavioral regimes: default convergence under open prompts, diversity activation via generic cues, and candidate realization through explicit enumeration.
paragraphs.zh: 第 4 节报告在通用基准提示下按维度划分的多样性特征。 在此，我们使用刻意留出目标维度的受控提示，以隔离预期目标维度存在多样性的场景。 该设计区分了三种行为模式：开放提示下的默认趋同、通过通用线索激活多样性，以及通过显式枚举实现候选方案。

sents.en: Section 4 reports dimension-wise diversity profiles on general-purpose benchmark prompts.
sents.zh: 第 4 节报告在通用基准提示下按维度划分的多样性特征。

sents.en: Here, we use controlled prompts that deliberately leave a target dimension open, isolating scenarios where diversity in the target dimension is expected.
sents.zh: 在此，我们使用刻意留出目标维度的受控提示，以隔离预期目标维度存在多样性的场景。

sents.en: This design distinguishes three behavioral regimes: default convergence under open prompts, diversity activation via generic cues, and candidate realization through explicit enumeration.
sents.zh: 该设计区分了三种行为模式：开放提示下的默认趋同、通过通用线索激活多样性，以及通过显式枚举实现候选方案。

paragraphs.en: We use a Specified prompt that specifies all four dimensions as the paired baseline, then vary only one target dimension under three interventions with progressively increasing information (Table 3 ). Specified prompts ensure dimensional independence as much as possible: replacing one dimension does not constrain the others. Omitted removes the target-dimension description, exposing the model’s unconstrained prior. Hinted replaces it with a dimension-level generic cue, testing whether a broad prompt can activate the dimension. Enumerated uses an LLM to enumerate prompts differing only in the target dimension, measuring model’s controllability to realize predefined variation. All interventions share the same semantic core, distinguishing among settings with no cue, a broad cue, and explicit candidates. The experiment covers 20 semantic groups. Annotation details are in Appendix D.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用一个指定了全部四个维度的 Specified 提示作为配对基线，然后在三种信息量逐步递增的干预下仅改变一个目标维度（表 3）。 Specified 提示尽可能确保各维度相互独立：替换其中一个维度不会对其他维度造成约束。 Omitted 移除目标维度的描述，暴露模型不受约束的先验。 Hinted 用维度层面的通用提示替代该描述，检验宽泛的提示能否激活该维度。 Enumerated 使用大语言模型枚举仅在目标维度上不同的提示，衡量模型实现预定义变化的可控性。 所有干预共享相同的语义核心，以此区分无提示、宽泛提示和显式候选这几种设置。 该实验涵盖 20 个语义组。 标注细节见附录 D.1。

paragraphs.en: Table 2 shows that, although removing or explicitly relaxing a constraint is expected to increase diversity, every dimension still contains cases that revert to a default preference. For example, under Omitted, Motion improves for only four models, with a mean change of merely + 0.011 +0.011 . Changing the generic wording gets consistent results: in motion and performing a clear action yield Motion improvements of + 0.069 +0.069 and + 0.054 +0.054 , respectively, both with positive responses in 6 / 7 6/7 models; similarly, camera moves and with clear camera movement yield Camera improvements of + 0.210 +0.210 and + 0.213 +0.213 , respectively, both with 7 / 7 7/7 model agreement. For Scene dimension, after adding a generic cue, somewhere yields only a + 0.005 +0.005 improvement over Omitted. These results indicate that open constraints primarily activate high-probability default solutions rather than reflecting the natural variance of the open prompt.
paragraphs.zh: 表2表明，尽管移除或显式放宽某个约束预期会增加多样性，但每个维度中仍然存在回退到默认偏好的情况。 例如，在「省略（Omitted）」条件下，运动（Motion）仅在四个模型上有所提升，平均变化仅为+0.011。 改变笼统的措辞得到了一致的结果：「正在进行一个清晰的动作」在运动（Motion）维度上分别带来+0.069和+0.054的提升，且均在6/7个模型中获得正向响应；类似地，「镜头移动」和「带有清晰的镜头运动」在相机（Camera）维度上分别带来+0.210和+0.213的提升，且均获得7/7个模型的一致认可。 在场景（Scene）维度上，在加入笼统提示后，「某个地方」相较于「省略（Omitted）」仅带来+0.005的提升。 这些结果表明，开放性约束主要激活的是高概率的默认解决方案，而非反映开放提示词的自然多样性。

paragraphs.en: The response to prompt specificity differs by dimension: For Scene dimension, the generic cue somewhere improves over Omitted by only + 0.005 +0.005 in the mean row, whereas explicit enumeration lifts diversity by + 0.313 +0.313 . The temporal dimensions instead respond gradually: in motion and camera moves improve over Omitted by + 0.058 +0.058 and + 0.118 +0.118 , and Motion enumeration further gains + 0.077 +0.077 . These profiles suggest that discrete, categorical dimensions such as Subject and Scene are unlocked only by explicit candidate enumeration, whereas temporal dimensions benefit from coupling high-level candidate planning with low-level execution constraints on trajectory and camera.
paragraphs.zh: 不同维度对提示具体性的响应存在差异：在场景（Scene）维度上，泛化提示 somewhere 在均值行上仅比 Omitted 提高 +0.005，而显式列举则使多样性提升 +0.313。 时间维度则呈渐进式响应：in motion 与 camera moves 分别比 Omitted 提高 +0.058 和 +0.118，而运动（Motion）列举进一步带来 +0.077 的增益。 这些特征表明，诸如主体（Subject）和场景（Scene）这类离散的、类别型的维度只有通过显式的候选列举才能解锁，而时间维度则受益于将高层次的候选规划与针对轨迹和相机的低层次执行约束相结合。

paragraphs.en: Explicit enumeration consistently improves diversity across all four dimensions for all models. However, compared with the corresponding Hinted prompts, mean Faithfulness decreases in all dimensions, with larger decreases in Motion and Camera than in Subject and Scene (Figure 6 a). Thus, larger MPD indicates candidate influence rather than faithful coverage; diversity and execution must be optimized jointly. Consequently, relying solely on text prompts to unlock fine-grained motion diversity is fundamentally bottlenecked, highlighting the necessity for future trajectory-based or multi-modal control signals to resolve temporal homogenization.
paragraphs.zh: 显式枚举在所有模型上都能持续提升全部四个维度的多样性。 然而，与相应的 Hinted 提示相比，所有维度上的平均忠实度均有所下降，其中 Motion 与 Camera 维度的下降幅度大于 Subject 与 Scene 维度（图 6 a）。 因此，更大的 MPD 表明的是候选的影响而非忠实的覆盖；多样性与执行必须联合优化。 因此，仅依靠文本提示来解锁细粒度的运动多样性在根本上受到瓶颈制约，这凸显了未来需要基于轨迹或多模态的控制信号来解决时间同质化问题的必要性。

paragraphs.en: Although enumeration obtains positive responses from all models, models differ substantially in realization faithfulness. In Figure 6 b, Seedance, HappyHorse, and Wan2.7 all show large Camera gains, with high faithfulness, whereas CogVideo and Wan2.2-5B gain slightly with low faithfulness; the latter two also rank last on the main Camera Table 1 . Furthermore, HappyHorse ranks last in Subject/Scene diversity while faithfully realizing the enumerated Subject and Scene candidates. The prompt-dependent default preference can likely be mitigated by prompt rewriting or decoding strategies, whereas capacity-limited failures call for better training data or architectural improvements. Our benchmark provides this model-level diagnosis.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管枚举能从所有模型获得正面响应，但各模型在实现忠实度上差异显著。 在图6b中，Seedance、HappyHorse和Wan2.7在Camera维度上都取得了大幅提升，且忠实度较高；而CogVideo和Wan2.2-5B提升较小且忠实度较低，后两者在主Camera表（表1）中也排名垫底。 此外，HappyHorse在Subject/Scene多样性上排名垫底，同时却能忠实地实现枚举出的Subject和Scene候选。 依赖提示词的默认偏好问题很可能可以通过提示词重写或解码策略来缓解，而受能力限制导致的失败则需要更好的训练数据或架构改进。 我们的基准测试提供了这种模型级别的诊断。

paragraphs.en: We introduce DiVid , a reproducible dimension-level diagnostic framework that localizes diversity collapse in video generation across six interpretable dimensions. Systematic evaluations of representative models reveal distinct collapse patterns hidden by global metrics. Joint analysis on faithfulness and quality confirms that these differences reflect genuine generation capabilities rather than off-prompt variation. Beyond diagnosis, we find that CFG cannot uniformly control all dimensions, particularly temporal ones, open-ended prompts lead models toward default preferences, and explicitly requested alternatives remain difficult to realize faithfully, again most notably for Motion and Camera. DiVid helps identify promising future directions: dimension-aware training objectives and richer control signals beyond text prompts for achieving diverse, controllable and faithful video generation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 DiVid，这是一个可复现的维度级诊断框架，可在六个可解释的维度上定位视频生成中的多样性坍缩。 对代表性模型的系统性评估揭示了被全局指标掩盖的独特坍缩模式。 对忠实度与质量的联合分析证实，这些差异反映的是真实的生成能力差异，而非偏离提示词的变化。 除诊断之外，我们发现 CFG 无法均匀地控制所有维度，尤其是时间相关维度；开放式提示会使模型趋向默认偏好；而明确要求的其他选择仍然难以忠实实现，其中在运动和镜头维度上尤为突出。 DiVid 有助于识别有前景的未来方向：维度感知的训练目标，以及超越文本提示的更丰富控制信号，以实现多样、可控且忠实的视频生成。

paragraphs.en: The four factor dimensions (Subject, Scene, Motion, Camera) depend on automatic extraction of video constituents. Accurate extraction is an independent line of work: subject detection and segmentation [ 38 , 50 ] , point tracking and optical flow [ 32 , 59 ] , and camera-motion understanding and pose estimation for video [ 36 , 35 ] . Recovering motion and camera information from 2D frames remains the hardest part [ 36 , 20 ] . Our aim is not more accurate extraction, but natural disentanglement of video constituents and set-level measurement of diversity. Every score is a pairwise similarity computed within the videos of the same prompt, aggregated at the prompt level, and used for relative ranking across models; Relative discriminability, reproducibility, and efficiency are what matter here. Appendix B.3 establishes the validity and robustness of the metrics through explicit validity controls, comprehensive data-quality statistics, human verification, and sensitivity analyses.
paragraphs.zh: 四个因素维度（主体、场景、运动、相机）依赖于对视频组成部分的自动提取。 精确提取本身是一条独立的研究方向：主体检测与分割 [ 38 , 50 ] 、点跟踪与光流 [ 32 , 59 ] ，以及针对视频的相机运动理解与位姿估计 [ 36 , 35 ] 。 从二维帧中恢复运动与相机信息仍然是最困难的部分 [ 36 , 20 ] 。 我们的目标不是更精确的提取，而是对视频组成部分的自然解耦以及集合层面上的多样性度量。 每个分数都是在同一提示词的视频内部计算的成对相似度，在提示词层面进行聚合，并用于跨模型的相对排序；这里重要的是相对可区分性、可复现性与效率。 附录 B.3 通过显式的有效性控制、全面的数据质量统计、人工验证以及敏感性分析，确立了这些指标的有效性与稳健性。

paragraphs.en: Our extraction accordingly follows the background-compensation paradigm validated in action recognition [ 63 ] , adapted to set-level measurement: we exclude the foreground with a dilated mask and fit a global partial-affine transform (translation, rotation, uniform scale) by RANSAC, which is richer than subtracting an averaged background vector from an averaged foreground vector [ 53 ] ; Motion adds a canonicalized deformation channel with two interpretable kernels for relative displacement and internal deformation; Camera aggregates translation, scale, and rotation into a 16-D descriptor; All key parameters are carefully selected by pilot analyses to reflect its intended factor and are then fixed across all models and prompts. The pipeline makes dimension-resolved diversity measurement efficient at benchmark scale. As motion and camera estimation for generated video improves in reliability and efficiency, we can update the corresponding modules.
paragraphs.zh: 相应地，我们的提取遵循在动作识别中经过验证的背景补偿范式 [63]，并将其适配到集合层面的度量：我们用膨胀掩码排除前景，并通过 RANSAC 拟合一个全局部分仿射变换（平移、旋转、均匀缩放），这比从平均前景向量中减去平均背景向量 [53] 更为丰富；Motion 增加了一个规范化的形变通道，包含两个可解释的核，分别用于相对位移和内部形变；Camera 将平移、缩放和旋转聚合为一个 16 维描述符；所有关键参数都通过试点分析精心选择，以反映其预期的因素，并在所有模型和提示词中保持固定。 该流程使得基于维度解析的多样性度量能够在基准测试规模下高效进行。 随着生成视频的运动和相机估计在可靠性与效率上的提升，我们可以更新相应的模块。

paragraphs.en: DiVid points to three complementary directions for diversity enhancement: data and training objectives determine which variations a model learns, control interfaces determine how users specify the desired variation, and inference strategies determine how to realize it.
paragraphs.zh: DiVid 指出了三个互补的多样性增强方向：数据与训练目标决定模型学习哪些变化，控制接口决定用户如何指定期望的变化，推理策略决定如何实现这些变化。

paragraphs.en: Data and Objectives. Section 5 shows that models often converge to dominant defaults. For example, HappyHorse repeatedly interprets an animal as a golden retriever, whereas explicitly listing candidates expands its Subject diversity. Meanwhile, the real-video retrieval reference in Appendix C.2 leads in the four content-related dimensions but ranks only fourth in Motion and Camera, suggesting that broad web-video coverage alone does not guarantee equally rich temporal variation. Prior image-generation studies similarly show that class imbalance causes tail-mode collapse, while global rebalancing can reduce overall fidelity [ 48 , 23 ] . Future methods should therefore curate data based on the diagnosed collapse dimensions and develop factor-specific training objectives that improve coverage and instruction following, rather than uniformly rebalancing the training distribution.
paragraphs.zh: 数据与目标。 第5节表明，模型常常收敛到占主导地位的默认模式。 例如，HappyHorse 反复将某种动物解读为金毛寻回犬，而显式列出候选对象则能扩大其主体（Subject）多样性。 与此同时，附录 C.2 中的真实视频检索参考方案在四个内容相关维度上领先，但在 Motion 和 Camera 上仅排名第四，这表明仅凭广泛的网络视频覆盖并不能保证同样丰富的时序变化。 先前的图像生成研究同样表明，类别不平衡会导致尾部模式坍缩，而全局再平衡可能降低整体保真度 [ 48 , 23 ] 。 因此，未来方法应基于诊断出的坍缩维度来筛选数据，并开发针对特定因子的训练目标，以提升覆盖度与指令遵循能力，而不是对训练分布进行统一的再平衡。

Explicitly listing candidates effectively expands discrete content factors, but produces less reliable gains in Motion and Camera. Text alone is therefore insufficient for precise control. Future systems could adopt hierarchical control, using text-level candidate specification for content factors and structured conditions for Motion and Camera, such as trajectories, keypoints, and camera paths.

paragraphs.en: Inference and Sampling. In Section 4.2 , we systematically examine how CFG scale affects each diversity dimension. As a preliminary feasibility check, we try adapting three diversity-enhancement methods from image generation to video: a bell-shaped CFG schedule; frequency-decoupled guidance with g = 1.5 g{=}1.5 for low frequencies and g = 5.0 g{=}5.0 for high frequencies [ 52 ] , and condition-annealed sampling that adds Gaussian noise to the T5 text embedding early in sampling and gradually reduces it to zero [ 51 ] . In pilot experiments, these methods do not produce consistent improvements across dimensions: some apply only to specific models, while others may trade quality for diversity. This exposes a common limitation of scalar guidance: it cannot select which factor to diversify. Future inference methods should instead use dimension-specific guidance and factor-aware sampling to explore the target dimension while jointly preserving quality and faithfulness.
paragraphs.zh: 推理与采样。 在第4.2节中，我们系统地检验了CFG尺度如何影响各个多样性维度。 作为初步可行性检查，我们尝试将三种来自图像生成的多样性增强方法适配到视频：钟形CFG调度；频率解耦引导，对低频使用 g = 1.5、对高频使用 g = 5.0 [52]；以及条件退火采样，在采样早期向T5文本嵌入添加高斯噪声并逐渐将其降至零 [51]。 在试点实验中，这些方法并未在各维度上产生一致的改进：一些方法仅适用于特定模型，而另一些方法可能以质量换取多样性。 这暴露了标量引导的一个共同局限：它无法选择要多样化的具体因子。 未来的推理方法应当改为使用维度特定的引导和因子感知的采样，在联合保持质量与忠实度的同时探索目标维度。

paragraphs.en: These three directions share one conclusion: a global diversity metric cannot provide a concrete optimization target, making dimension-level diagnosis essential for targeted enhancement. Recent controllable video-generation methods use structured camera poses, trajectories, or flow to control camera and object motion [ 20 , 64 , 17 , 9 , 61 , 15 ] , with newer approaches further disentangling these factors or composing their control over longer horizons [ 43 , 62 ] . These advances provide practical mechanisms for acting on our diagnosis. DiVid complements them by locating the collapsed factor, evaluating whether a control method expands its intended dimension, and providing a low-cost automatic signal for training or sampling while jointly monitoring quality and faithfulness.
paragraphs.zh: 这三个方向共同得出一个结论：全局多样性指标无法提供具体的优化目标，因此必须进行维度层面的诊断，才能实现有针对性的增强。 近期的可控视频生成方法使用结构化的相机位姿、轨迹或光流来控制相机和物体运动 [ 20 , 64 , 17 , 9 , 61 , 15 ] ，较新的方法进一步解耦这些因素，或在更长时间范围内组合它们的控制 [ 43 , 62 ] 。 这些进展为基于我们的诊断采取行动提供了实用的机制。 DiVid 对它们起到补充作用：定位发生坍缩的因子，评估某种控制方法是否扩展了其目标维度，并在训练或采样时提供低成本的自动信号，同时联合监测质量与忠实度。

paragraphs.en: We define the subject as the foreground entity in a video that is clearly visible, recognizable, and suitable for stable localization and segmentation. By default, we retain only the single most central subject. Multiple subjects are annotated only when the prompt contains clearly coordinated core entities. Subject labels are normalized to generic, single-word category nouns (e.g., person , dog , and car ), without modifiers such as color, material, age, or style, and without proper names or character names. Nouns appearing in prepositional phrases, supporting objects, and background reference objects are usually not annotated as subjects. We use GPT-5 to produce the initial subject annotations for all 206 prompts, and the annotation instruction is shown in Figure 19 . For the prompts in Section 5 , the subject labels are predefined during prompt construction. After the initial annotation, we asked three annotators to manually review all subject labels. For 94.7% of the prompts, the GPT-5 annotation was unanimously accepted by all three annotators. For the remaining prompts with disagreement, we adopted a majority-vote strategy and used the label preferred by most annotators as the final subject annotation.

paragraphs.en: GroundingDINO scans up to 32 sampled frames for an initialization box, using box and text thresholds of 0.30 and 0.25. SAM 2 then propagates each detected subject mask both forward and backward. A video is retained only if every annotated subject has at least three mask frames whose area lies between 0.1% and 95% of the image. Multi-subject instances are tracked separately before aggregation. At the prompt level, a factor is excluded rather than assigned zero when fewer than two videos, or fewer than 30% of the generated videos, retain valid subject masks. Subject and Scene use complementary leakage controls. For Subject, pixels outside the mask are replaced by the frame-wise RGB mean before the tight crop is encoded. For Scene, the masked foreground is replaced by a Gaussian-blurred region with radius 12. For temporal metrics, Camera samples background points outside a five-pixel dilation of the subject mask, while Motion samples subject points from an eroded interior region. This exclusion margin reduces boundary contamination in both directions.
paragraphs.zh: GroundingDINO 会扫描最多 32 个采样帧以获取初始化框，框阈值和文本阈值分别为 0.30 和 0.25。 随后 SAM 2 对每个检测到的主体掩码进行前向和后向传播。 只有当每个标注主体都拥有至少三个掩码帧，且其面积介于图像面积的 0.1% 到 95% 之间时，该视频才会被保留。 多主体实例会在聚合之前被分开跟踪。 在提示层面，当保留有效主体掩码的视频少于两个，或少于生成视频的 30% 时，该因素会被排除而非赋值为零。 主体与场景采用互补的泄漏控制方式。 对于主体，在编码紧裁剪之前，掩码外的像素会被替换为逐帧的 RGB 均值。 对于场景，被掩码的前景会被替换为半径为 12 的高斯模糊区域。 对于时间维度指标，相机在主体掩码五像素膨胀之外采样背景点，而运动则从腐蚀后的内部区域采样主体点。 这一排除余量在两个方向上都减少了边界污染。

paragraphs.en: CoTracker is initialized at four temporal anchors using a 10 × 10 10\times 10 subject grid and a 12 × 12 12\times 12 background grid. Motion is accepted only when both the background-compensated trajectory and canonical-deformation branches pass their validity checks.
paragraphs.zh: CoTracker 使用 10 × 10 10\times 10 的主体网格和 12 × 12 12\times 12 的背景网格在四个时间锚点处初始化。 几何估计至少需要 12 个主体点和 20 个背景点。 背景变换用 RANSAC 拟合，置信度低于 0.35 时被拒绝；主体轨迹还要求内点比例至少为 0.50。 只有当至少两个帧对有效且已尝试的帧对中至少 25% 有效时，才会保留相机或轨迹描述符。 只有当背景补偿轨迹和规范形变两个分支都通过有效性检查时，运动才会被接受。

paragraphs.en: Among all videos, all annotated subjects receive an initialization detection in 98.85% of cases; conditional on detection, SAM 2 execution succeeds in 99.94%, and 96.60% of all expected videos pass the complete mask-validity gate. paragraphs.en: Subject, Scene, Motion, and Camera require an explicit, localizable subject. Most prompts in our benchmark specify a focal entity, covering the vast majority of the evaluated prompts and common text-to-video use cases. Prompts outside this scope are excluded by the explicit validity checks. Motion and Camera are 2D image-plane measurements. The partial-affine Camera descriptor captures dominant global shot motion rather than full 3D camera pose. Strong parallax, dynamic backgrounds, or shot cuts may require richer geometric models, while Motion remains sensitive to tracking quality and does not assess physical correctness. We therefore use these dimensions to diagnose visible motion and camera diversity at the model level.
paragraphs.zh: Subject（主体）、Scene（场景）、Motion（运动）和 Camera（相机）都要求存在一个明确的、可定位的主体。 我们基准中的大多数提示词都指定了一个焦点实体，覆盖了绝大多数被评估的提示词和常见的文本到视频应用场景。 超出该范围之外的提示词会被显式的有效性检查排除。 Motion（运动）和 Camera（相机）是二维图像平面上的测量指标。 部分仿射的 Camera（相机）描述符捕捉的是主导性的全局镜头运动，而非完整的 3D 相机位姿。 强视差、动态背景或镜头切换可能需要更丰富的几何模型，同时 Motion（运动）对跟踪质量较为敏感，且不评估物理正确性。 因此，我们使用这些维度在模型层面诊断可见的运动与相机多样性。

paragraphs.en: As with other feature-based diversity metrics, DiVid measures variation through specific encoders. We use representations matched to each dimension and validate them meticulously. paragraphs.en: We recruited six trained annotators and randomly sampled 50 prompts from different categories. For each prompt, three disjoint model pairs were randomly drawn from all seven models, producing 150 unique prompt–model-pair items. Each pair was judged on six diversity dimensions using a five-level ordered scale: A clearly more diverse / A slightly more diverse / about the same / B slightly more diverse / B clearly more diverse . Each annotator evaluated 40 model pairs, resulting in 240 valid judgments that ensure full coverage of all 150 items, with 90 items evaluated by two annotators to allow for inter-annotator agreement analysis. Model identity, file names, left/right position, and within-set video order were hidden or randomized throughout. Annotators also rated on factor-level faithfulness across four dimensions (Subject, Scene, Motion, and Camera). Specifically, given the prompt’s description for each factor, annotators judged whether the generated videos faithfully followed the corresponding constraint on a 1–5 scale; N/A was selected when the prompt did not specify that factor. Strict requires the automatic and human scores to be identical, while Direction counts agreement when both scores are positive (4–5), both are negative (1–2), or both are N/A.
paragraphs.zh: 我们招募了六名经过培训的标注员，并从不同类别中随机抽取了 50 个提示词。 对于每个提示词，我们从全部七个模型中随机抽取三个互不重叠的模型对，得到 150 个唯一的「提示词–模型对」条目。 每个模型对在六个多样性维度上采用五级有序量表进行评判：A 明显更多样 / A 略更多样 / 大致相同 / B 略更多样 / B 明显更多样。 每名标注员评估 40 个模型对，共产生 240 条有效评判，确保对全部 150 个条目的完整覆盖，其中 90 个条目由两名标注员评估，以便进行标注员间一致性分析。 模型身份、文件名、左右位置以及集合内的视频顺序在整个过程中均被隐藏或随机化。 标注员还对四个维度（主体、场景、运动和镜头）的因素级忠实度进行了评分。 具体而言，针对提示词中对每个因素的描述，标注员以 1–5 分制判断生成的视频是否忠实遵循了相应的约束；当提示词未指定该因素时，则选择 N/A。 Strict 要求自动评分与人工评分完全一致，而 Direction 在两者评分均为正面（4–5）、均为负面（1–2）或均为 N/A 时计入一致。

paragraphs.en: All annotators hold at least a bachelor’s degree and completed a unified training session covering the judgment criteria for each dimension before the formal evaluation began. We explicitly train annotators to focus solely on diversity variations in the specific dimension, avoiding confusion. For motion-related dimensions (Motion and Camera), the annotation interface enforced a minimum playback requirement: annotators must have watched at least 80% of the total video duration before submission was enabled. Appearance dimensions (Subject, Scene) and motion dimensions (Motion, Camera) were presented on separate screens to minimize cross-dimension interference. To monitor annotation reliability, we inserted 2–3 gold standard items per batch of 40 judgments. Each gold item consisted of one set containing 2–3 identical duplicate videos, and the other contained 10 manually curated, clearly distinct videos spanning diverse content. Across all annotators and gold items, every response correctly identified the set of distinct videos as clearly more diverse. These checks confirm that annotators remained attentive and applied the diversity criteria consistently throughout the study.

paragraphs.en: Table 11 confirms the central cross-dimensional reversal. Relative to Hunyuan, Wan2.2-5B achieves higher MPD across all four content dimensions, with paired differences of 0.027–0.054 and confidence intervals that exclude zero ( q < 4.7 × 10 − 8 q<4.7\times 10^{-8} ). Conversely, Hunyuan exceeds Wan2.2-5B by 0.107 in Motion and 0.394 in Camera (both q < 5.0 × 10 − 20 q<5.0\times 10^{-20} ). These prompt-paired results statistically substantiate the opposing content-versus-temporal diversity profiles reported in the main text. Together with the observation that six of the seven models span at least three rank positions across the six dimensions, they show that model diversity cannot be represented by a single global ordering and must instead be characterized dimension by dimension.
paragraphs.zh: 表11证实了核心的跨维度反转现象。 相对于混元，Wan2.2-5B在全部四个内容维度上均取得更高的MPD，成对差异为0.027–0.054，且置信区间不包含零（q < 4.7 × 10⁻⁸）。 相反，混元在运动（Motion）维度上超出Wan2.2-5B 0.107，在镜头（Camera）维度上超出0.394（两者均q < 5.0 × 10⁻²⁰）。 这些提示配对的结果从统计上证实了正文中报告的相反的内容多样性与时间多样性特征。 结合七个模型中有六个在六个维度上跨越至少三个排名位置这一观察结果，这些结果表明模型多样性无法用单一的全局排序来表示，而必须逐个维度进行刻画。

paragraphs.en: Video generation models are commonly trained on large-scale video–text datasets [ 5 , 44 ] . To provide a reference for existing diversity metrics and estimate diversity exhibited by real web videos, we design a retrieval-based pipeline over approximately one million captions from OpenVid-1M [ 44 ] . paragraphs.en: As shown in Table 12 , the retrieved videos achieve quality scores comparable to those of the evaluated generators and rank first in Semantic, Style, Subject, Scene, and six-dimension average diversity, but only fourth in Motion and Camera. This real-video reference further confirms that diversity is dimension-specific: even broad content variation does not imply equally rich temporal variation. paragraphs.zh: 如表 12 所示，检索到的视频在质量得分上与被评估的生成器相当，并在语义、风格、主体、场景以及六维平均多样性上排名第一，但在运动和镜头上仅排名第四。 这一真实视频参照进一步证实了多样性是维度特定的：即使是广泛的内容变化也不意味着同样丰富的时序变化。 这也表明，仅依靠大规模网络视频数据可能无法为运动和镜头多样性提供足够的监督，因此需要进行维度感知的数据筛选和结构化的时序控制，而非全局的数据再平衡。
